evidence.quote: Basic Auth is available only with username and app password as credentials.
Returns the list of members in a workspace and their permission levels.
Returns a paginated list of webhooks installed on this workspace.

assumptions: The workspace slug is entered as a connection setting rather than discovered automatically.

The source text is cut off, so the per-member last-accessed field (last_accessed) and the permission (role) field are not confirmed in the response sample. Bitbucket says last_accessed disappears once administration moves to admin.atlassian.com, so last-active data may be empty for those accounts.
The page size of 100 and the pagelen size parameter are assumptions; the source does not state a maximum.
Next-page links are assumed to come back in the 'next' field, as shown in the response samples.
Email addresses and account status are not returned by this endpoint, so they are left empty. Suspended or deactivated members may not be listed.
OAuth client credentials are not documented, so only the authorization code flow and app passwords are listed. Both are tied to a person, so access may stop if that person leaves.
Rate limits are not stated in the source.

readSteps.title: Work out how to sign in
readSteps.description: OAuth 2.0 or Username and app password. "Basic Auth is available only with username and app password as credentials."

readSteps.title: Find user endpoints
readSteps.description: GET /workspaces/{workspace}/permissions. "Returns the list of members in a workspace and their permission levels."

readSteps.title: Find usage endpoints
readSteps.description: No usage endpoint needed. Last activity is on the user record. "`last_accessed` and `added_"

readSteps.title: Detect paging
readSteps.description: next link in next, followed only on the API host. "Returns a paginated list of webhooks installed on this workspace."
